properties.name: sovereignty.vector-store.provider
properties.description: The vector store provider. Option can be 'internal' (JSON-based) or 'pgvector' (PostgreSQL).

properties.name: sovereignty.vector-store.file-path
properties.description: File path where vector store content is persisted for the internal provider.

properties.name: sovereignty.storage.provider
properties.description: Storage provider for raw uploaded documents.

properties.name: sovereignty.storage.path
properties.description: File system path where uploaded documents are stored.

properties.name: sovereignty.messaging.provider
properties.description: Messaging provider. Options are 'internal' (in-memory async virtual threads) or 'kafka'.
